name: preadd_16bit_wrap
why: the symmetric pre-adder keeps 16 bits, so x[n-k] + x[n-15+k] wraps for large same-sign samples

name: truncate_not_round
why: drops the rounding constant, so results floor instead of rounding half up

name: positive_saturation_wraps
why: positive overflow wraps to a negative value instead of saturating at 32767

name: wrong_preadd_pair
why: pairs tap 3 with tap 11 instead of its mirror tap 12

name: history_shift_on_valid
why: the history shifts on in_valid alone, so a blocked sample enters it repeatedly

name: bubble_not_collapsed
why: slot 4 advances only when the output can, so a gap in front of a stalled output never closes

name: stall_overwrites_output
why: a valid token in slot 4 overwrites the stalled output result and is lost

name: reset_keeps_history
why: reset empties the slots but leaves the old samples in the delay line

name: asynchronous_reset
why: an off-edge reset pulse empties the pipeline and clears the history
replace: always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin // fir_pipe
